parameters.jsCode: const raw=$input.first().json; const source=$('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json; let parsed=raw; const text=raw.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text; if(text){try{parsed=JSON.parse(text.replace(/^```json\s*|```$/g,'').trim())}catch(e){return [{json:{status:'needs_more_information',request_id:source.request_id||null,missing_fields:['structured_gemini_output'],error:{code:'GEMINI_INVALID_JSON',message:e.message}}}]}} const required=['title','start_date','duration_minutes']; const missing=required.filter(k=>parsed[k]===undefined||parsed[k]===null||parsed[k]===''); if(missing.length) return [{json:{status:'needs_more_information',request_id:source.request_id||null,missing_fields:missing}}]; return [{json:{...source,...parsed,status:'ready',preferred_period:parsed.preferred_period||'any',busy_events:[],weather_data:[]}}];
